explore.name: Explore Agent
explore.description: Fast agent for codebase exploration and research
explore.useCase: Multiple independent research threads, cross-cutting investigations

task.name: Task Agent
task.description: Execute commands with verbose output (tests, builds, lints)
task.useCase: Running builds, tests, linting, and installation commands

general-purpose.name: General Purpose Agent
general-purpose.description: Full-capability agent for complex multi-step tasks
general-purpose.useCase: Complex multi-step tasks requiring complete toolset and reasoning

code-review.name: Code Review Agent
code-review.description: Read-only reviewer of diffs and code changes
code-review.useCase: Reviewing staged, unstaged, or branch diffs for bugs and vulnerabilities

security-review.name: Security Review Agent
security-review.useCase: Finding exploitable security vulnerabilities and security issues

copilot.agents.recommendations.when_to_use_explore: Use for independent research threads requiring substantial separate context (multiple unrelated questions, complex cross-cutting investigations). For simple lookups, use grep/glob/view directly.
copilot.agents.recommendations.when_to_use_task: Use for commands where you only need to know success/failure status. Returns brief summary on success, full output on failure.
copilot.agents.recommendations.when_to_use_general_purpose: Use for complex multi-step tasks requiring the complete toolset and high-quality reasoning in a separate context window.
copilot.agents.recommendations.when_to_use_code_review: Use for reviewing existing staged, unstaged, or branch diffs. Reports only high-confidence bugs and security vulnerabilities.
copilot.agents.recommendations.when_to_use_security_review: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to find security vulnerabilities, before investigating directly.
